```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExternalRedactionFinding, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractWithExternalRedaction } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { bytes: Uint8Array.from([90, 111, 195, 171, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 46]), filename: "external-findings-default.txt", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" };
  const result = await extractWithExternalRedaction(input, undefined, [{ end: 4, label: "inspection_person", score: 0.99, start: 0 } as ExternalRedactionFinding], undefined, 8);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
}

void main();
```
